personality: 3 Editorial Mobile LIGHT fused with 6 Glass / Luxe premium e-commerce structure
personality_one_liner: A highly curated, tactile, and elegant marketplace treating African wax fabrics as luxury, contemporary art.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room for an editorial feel. Components should never feel cramped.

do's: Use on sticky headers over scrolling content
Use on the bottom tab bar to let fabric images peek through
Use on sticky 'Add to Cart' containers at the bottom of Product Detail screens
dont's: Do not use on regular product cards
Do not use on form inputs

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Showcase premium fabrics, curated collections, and top creators.

states.loading: Skeleton loaders for hero card and category lists.
states.error: Unable to load trends. Retry button.

screens.layout: Hero section featuring a large featured fabric card (with gradient scrim and text overlay). Below it, horizontally scrolling pills for categories. A horizontal list for 'Popular Creators' (circular avatars or portrait cards), followed by a 2-column grid of 'Trending Pagne'.

screens.name: Shop
screens.purpose: Main browsing interface for fabrics and clothing.

states.empty: No products match the selected filters. Illustration + 'Clear filters' CTA.

screens.layout: Sticky glass header with a search bar and filter button. A 2-column grid for products. Each card has an image, title, price, and a small Terracotta/Gold badge if on sale or premium.

screens.name: ProductDetail
screens.purpose: Provide deep context and purchasing capability for a fabric/item.
screens.layout: Large, full-width image gallery at the top (pagination dots). Title, price, and creator info below with generous spacing. Expandable 'About the pattern' section. Fixed glassmorphism container at the bottom with a primary CTA (Noir profond) to 'Add to Cart'.

screens.name: Models
screens.purpose: Inspiration gallery of tailor-made clothing using the fabrics.
screens.layout: Masonry or large vertical card layout. Images take priority, with minimal UI. Tapping a model shows which fabric was used and links to the tailor.

screens.name: CreatorProfile
screens.purpose: Showcase a tailor or vendor's bespoke identity and listings.
screens.layout: Cover image banner at the top, creator avatar overlapping it. Bio text. Segmented tabs (Glass surface) for 'Fabrics', 'Models', 'Reviews'.

screens.name: Messages
screens.purpose: Allow buyers to chat with tailors for custom orders.

states.empty: No messages yet. 'Find a Tailor' CTA.

screens.layout: Standard list of conversation threads with unread indicators in Terracotta (#B85C38).

screens.name: CartCheckout
screens.purpose: Review items and complete the purchase.
screens.layout: List of items with thumbnail, title, and quantity adjusters. Subtotal section. Sticky 'Checkout' CTA at the bottom.

hero_background.alt: Colorful textiles with intricate African wax print patterns hanging on display

creator_cover.alt: Young African fashion model in a beautifully patterned ankara dress

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the selected color palette. Use the primary 'Noir profond' (#111111) for high-impact elements like the main CTA to achieve a premium e-commerce look.
Use Manrope for both display and text typography. Maintain varying sizes (e.g., 24pt for headers, 16pt for body) and weight strictly capped at 500.
Avoid using indigo, blue, or purple anywhere. Use the Terracotta (#B85C38) and Gold (#C8A96B) exclusively for accents, unread badges, and premium indications.
All cards containing images must have slightly rounded corners (`md` / 12px) and no drop shadows (tier 0). Let the layout breathe with spacing rather than outlining everything.
Whenever text overlaps an image (like in the Hero component or Creator Banner), a top-to-bottom gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse) is MANDATORY.
Implement glassmorphism for sticky action bars, such as the bottom tab bar and the sticky 'Add to Cart' footer on product detail pages.
Add subtle haptic feedback for adding items to the cart, sending messages, and switching main tabs.
Follow the 5-tab bottom navigation: Accueil (Home), Boutique (Shop), Modèles (Models), Messages, Profil (Profile).
